render_gaussian_splat_scene: render a 3D Gaussian splat scene given camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and primitive attributes into a color image
render_with_depth_map: render a 3D Gaussian splat scene and return both color and depth maps using the render function
render_with_custom_background: render a 3D Gaussian splat scene with a custom background color tensor passed to the render function
render_without_depth: render a 3D Gaussian splat scene returning only color and alpha by setting return_depth to False
render_with_global_scale: render a 3D Gaussian splat scene with a custom global_scale factor to resize all primitives uniformly
